answer.summary: Every failing test is a Spring ApplicationContext load failure caused by one deterministic error: the query on PayloadIdentityRepository.findAllActionIdsByTenantIdWithOlderVersionsInUse is rejected by JSqlParser (ParseException near "ANDi", line 15, col 68). PayloadIdentityRepository.java is in this change, so the change broke startup. The 10 listed test failures are a cascade from that one context failure, so their flake history does not matter. Re-running will fail the same way. The HEAD timeout on line 1214 was recovered and is unrelated.

evidence.quote: Error creating bean with name 'payloadIdentityRepository' defined in io.openaev.database.repository.PayloadIdentityRepository
Caused by: java.lang.IllegalArgumentException: The query you provided is not a valid SQL Query
Caused by: net.sf.jsqlparser.parser.ParseException: Encountered: <S_IDENTIFIER> / "ANDi", at line 15, column 68, in lexical state DEFAULT.
